caption: The drawing depicts a single dress rendered in a pale, neutral color, likely white or light grey, displayed against an off-white background. The dress features a high waistline, commonly called an empire waist, which is gathered just below a square neckline. The sleeves are short and puffed, ending above the elbows, and are similarly gathered and finished with decorative embroidery. Additional embroidery embellishes the area near the neckline as well as the hem of the skirt; the hem embroidery depicts a repeating pattern of curved leaf or feather motifs. The skirt falls straight and long to the ankles, creating a simple, elongated silhouette. There are no additional objects or background elements in the composition.
